title: Implement run_patch_test() and run_rigid_body_test()
objective: Implement run_patch_test() and run_rigid_body_test() in verify/patch_test.py. Patch test compares generated solver output against analytical.patch_test_reference() (error < 1e-12). Rigid body test asserts internal force norm < 1e-12.
implementation_steps: Implement run_patch_test: compile solver, set constant-strain BCs, run, compare vs analytical
Implement run_rigid_body_test: compile solver, set rigid body BCs, run, check internal force norm
Handle mesh generation for irregular Hex8 (perturbed nodes)
acceptance_criteria: Patch test passes for SVK on regular mesh (error < 1e-12)
Works with generated solver from compile()
risks: Risk: generated solver requires external BC enforcement (Sprint 1 gap). Mitigation: use same _newton_with_bc() pattern from test_e2e_taichi.py.
